ui.title: I-atlasi yezimpumelelo ze-GitHub
ui.name: Igama
ui.moved: Le nguqulo ithuthelwe ku-catalog/. Isixhumanisi esingenhla sivula inguqulo entsha ephelele.
ui.intro: Umhlahlandlela wamabheji e-GitHub asesidlangalaleni, omlando, okuhlola nangaphakathi.
ui.limits: Kufakwe amabheji abhalwe esidlangalaleni kuphela; konke ukuhlola kwangaphakathi okungadalulwanga akukwazi ukuqinisekiswa.
ui.incident: I-GitHub yabika ukubambezeleka kokunikeza nokubonisa ngo-2026-09-23; ukungabonakali akusho ukuhoxiswa.
ui.active_note: Imikhawulo isekelwe ekuqapheleni komphakathi. Iminikelo yangasese ingabalwa uma isilungiselelo sivuliwe.
ui.retired_note: Le micimbi isiphelile. Imiklomelo emidala ingahlala; iminikelo emisha ayiyivuli.
ui.experimental_note: I-GitHub yaqinisekisa ukuthi ukubuyiselwa ngoMashi 2026 kwakuyiphutha; alukho usuku lokukhishwa esidlangalaleni.
ui.internal_note: Izigaba zangaphakathi ze-Proxima; ayikho indlela yomphakathi noma usuku lokuyeka oluqinisekisiwe.
ui.tiers_note: Isisekelo → ithusi → isiliva → igolide. x2/x3/x4 yizimpawu zamazinga. Kusukela ngo-2026-09-11 kuboniswa izinga eliphezulu.
ui.experimental_tiers: Izithombe zokuhlola zikhona; imikhawulo elandelayo yimibiko yesikhashana yomphakathi, hhayi imithetho eqinisekisiwe.
ui.variants_note: Imibala yesikhumba ye-Starstruck ne-Quickdraw ishintsha ukubukeka kuphela.
ui.highlights_note: Ama-Highlights ayizimpawu ezihlukile zezinhlelo nama-akhawunti; ukutholakala kuncike ohlelweni.
ui.history_note: Imiklamo yokuqala yayisetshenziswa ngo-2021-04-19 kuya ku-2022-06-09; amagama amadala awazona izimpumelelo ezengeziwe.
ui.proxima_note: Izithombe namakhadi kuyavumelana: Pioneer — isibonelo M0; Staffshipper — isistimu M8; Staffuser — iqembu liyajoyina.
ui.inaccessible_note: “inaccessible” kusho ukungabi nemvume yokubona umcimbi. Staffshipper: esithombeni 2024-08-22, ku-UTC 2024-08-21.
ui.sources_note: Izimemezelo ezisemthethweni ziqinisekisa isimo, amakhadi imicimbi; imikhawulo yomphakathi isalokhu ingukuqaphela.

descriptions.starstruck: Dala indawo yokugcina enezinkanyezi **eziyi-16**; amazinga aphezulu ancike ezinkanyezini zayo.
descriptions.pull-shark: Yiba umbhali wama-**pull request amabili ahlanganisiwe**.
descriptions.pair-extraordinaire: Bhala ama-commit ngokuhlanganyela ku-**PR eyodwa ehlanganisiwe**, usebenzise `Co-authored-by` ngokufanele.
descriptions.galaxy-brain: Thola **izimpendulo ezimbili ezamukelwe** ku-Discussions. Ku-`github.com/orgs/community` kukhutshaziwe kusukela ngo-2024-02-06.
descriptions.quickdraw: Vala i-issue noma i-PR **kungakapheli imizuzu emihlanu** uyivulile.
descriptions.yolo: Hlanganisa i-PR yakho **ngaphandle kokubuyekezwa kwekhodi**; imithetho esemthethweni enemininingwane ayishicilelwe.
descriptions.public-sponsor: Xhasa umthuthukisi noma inhlangano esidlangalaleni nge-**GitHub Sponsors**.
descriptions.arctic-code-vault-contributor: Nikela endaweni efanele ku-**Arctic Code Vault snapshot yango-2020-02-02**. Umcimbi uvaliwe.
descriptions.mars-2020-contributor: Bhala i-commit enguqulweni ethile esetshenziswe yi-**NASA/JPL Ingenuity**. Umcimbi usuphelile.
descriptions.heart-on-your-sleeve: Ukuhlola ukusabela ❤️; ukukhishwa okuyiphutha ngoMashi 2026 kwahoxiswa. Ayikho indlela yamanje eqinisekisiwe.
descriptions.open-sourcerer: Ukuhlola ama-PR ahlanganisiwe ezindaweni eziningi zomphakathi; imithetho eqondile ayishicilelwe.
descriptions.proxima-pioneer: **M0 Participant** — umnikelo ku-**Proxima proof of concept (POC)**, kubonwe ku-@JakubOleksy.
descriptions.proxima-staffshipper: **M8 Participant** — ukwethula **isistimu ye-Proxima Staffship**, kubonwe ku-@JakubOleksy.
descriptions.proxima-staffuser: **Iqembu lijoyine i-Proxima**, kubonwe ku-@timrogers. Umklomelo wesithathu we-Proxima owaziwayo.

highlights.developer-program: Joyina i-Developer Program wakhe uhlelo nge-GitHub API.
highlights.bug-bounty: Bika ubuthakathaka bokuphepha obufanele be-GitHub nge-Bug Bounty.
highlights.campus-expert: Joyina i-GitHub Campus Experts; hlola imithetho yezicelo yamanje.
highlights.security-advisory: Thola ukuqashelwa kumnikelo weseluleko sokuphepha esamukelwe ku-GitHub Advisory Database.
highlights.github-star: Khethwa ku-GitHub Stars; izinkanyezi zendawo yokugcina kuphela azanele.
highlights.discussion-answered: Uphawu oludala lwezimpendulo ezamukelwe; umphakathi wabika ukushintshwa yi-Galaxy Brain ngo-2022.
